what: NDT-POOL (2026-10-13): the pool's tasks claimed from one counter, a hot path without the lock, a worker's wait as pauses, then yields, then sleep. Measured as drafts in three stages, then the landed budget (64 pauses, 512 yields); the step's pairs alternate the tree with NDT-PASS and NDT-ATTN-1..3 applied ('slices', the tree before NDT-POOL) against it with NDT-POOL ('pool'), with the tree before all four ('before') in the same rounds.
host: 4-vCPU Intel Xeon container (AVX-512), GCC 13.3 (the trainer builds), Python 3.11.15 (the declared floor); indicative wall times, no PMU

files.bench_pool.c: the pool's latency: a job of N tasks each spinning W ns, back to back or after a serial gap on the caller; mean microseconds per job, best of 5 rounds (gcc -std=c11 -O3 -pthread bench_pool.c bcir_tensor.c -lm; -DBCIR_POOL_SPINS/-DBCIR_POOL_YIELDS for a budget)
files.pool-latency.json: bench_pool.c at four threads over the three stages' builds, on the quiet host and with two (stages 1-3) and three (stage 3) CPUs held by busy loops
files.fma_topology.c, fma-topology.json: twelve FMA chains in registers pinned to one CPU, to each pair and to all four, twice: 141-148 GFLOP/s one, 284-300 any pair, 579-584 all four -- four cores, each with its own FMA units
files.gemm_rates.py: the step's 15 GEMM shapes at four threads on two builds, alternated call by call, every pooled result checked bit for bit against the serial kernel (python3 gemm_rates.py A.so B.so OUT.json 4 15)
files.gemm-rates-*.json: stage1/2/3: the pool before against each stage's draft; static: the landed protocol with the fixed assignment against it with claims; landed-1..3: 51ec5bc against NDT-POOL as landed (landed-3 with the committed gemm_rates.py)
files.attribution-t4-{before,slices,pool}-{1,2: measurements/2026-10-13/scan/attribution.py in place at four threads, the three trees alternated in each of three rounds
files.breakdown-bcir-kblock+exp+reduce-t4-{bef: four alternated pairs of the 2026-10-11 harness's bcir-breakdown stage (--rounds 5 --threads 4 --contract kblock+exp+reduce): before = the tree with NDT-PASS and NDT-ATTN-1..3, after = with NDT-POOL
files.identity-after.json: the harness's identity stage on the tree with all four slices, 20 steps at 1 and 4 threads: 4bf4e057..., the state of measurements/2026-10-13/scan/
